title: Write smoke tests for the psp-etl stats CLI command (issue L1). Create tests/test_cli_stats.py. Tests must cover: (1) empty DB: all four tables render (Images per Vendor, Entries per Generation, String Score Distribution, Score Summary) with 'no data' placeholders, exit 0. (2) populated DB: insert images and entries across two vendors and two generations, verify vendor names and generation names appear in output. (3) populated with string_analysis: verify score distribution table shows Min/Mean/P90/Max values. (4) --gen filter: insert zen2 and zen3 entries, filter to zen2, verify zen3 does not appear in output. All tests use --data-dir tmp_path and CliRunner(env={'COLUMNS': '200'}). Run uv run --extra dev pytest tests/ -q. Commit and close issue L1.
